header: The exact marker of a doctor (step 54a). When a name matches more than one doctor, the screen ASKS which one (radio buttons: the same ask as the department question, mode "one", built in engine.ts) and I search the person's OWN question again with the chosen doctor named by an exact marker: the ticket of a permanent doctor, the list number of a non-permanent one. So a date or a day in the question survives the click, and the same question can never ask again. Only hospital doctors are offered; "search all employees" is a separate button.

doc: "(ticket 490138)", "(list no. D499964)" or "(doctor <id>)": a marker I add to a question to name one doctor exactly.
